events.title: New Demo Version out now
events.summary: Language support for subtitles and performance optimization have been added following your feedback!

events.title: Aesthetica Short Film Festival 2026 (ASFF) Selection
events.summary: Very excited to share that When the Embers Wake has been selected for the Aesthetica Short Film Festival 2026 (ASFF) as part of this year’s Games Lab Official Selection! It feels especially lovely to see the game continuing its festival journey after also being featured at the indie Live Expo. When the Embers Wake started as a small story about Emmie, her mother, and the fragile world around them, so seeing it reach audiences through events like these means a lot to us. We’ll be heading to York

events.title: When the Embers Wake Game Demo
events.summary: Our first demo for When the Embers Wake is out.It delivers a sentimental 15-minute journey that actually makes you feel something real. If you’re craving a story that moves you emotionally... what’s stopping you from trying it?

events.title: When the Embers Wake Featured at INDIE Live Expo Spring Showcase
events.summary: We're excited to share that When the Embers Wake has been selected to be featured at the INDIE Live Expo Spring Showcase on April 25, 2026!If you'd like to watch the showcase, you can get notified here: Thank you for your support — we're truly grateful for this opportunity!

events.title: DEVLOG #001
events.summary: Dev-Update / Devlog - Check out the latest Video 🎬Hi everyone, we just dropped a short video teaser of our progress showing our Red Panda Mummy showing the main character the ways of red panda life!Watch it for a quick glimpse of where we’re at: art, atmosphere, and mood.We’re still polishing many things, but this gives you a taste of what’s coming. Let us know what you think! Any feedback welcome 👇Thanks Llamaplay Devs
